name: Disneyland & DCA Warm Mickey-Shaped Soft Pretzel (Brush Off Coarse Salt, Skip Jalapeño Cheese)
brandOrRestaurant: Refreshment Corner & Pretzel Carts (Disneyland & California Adventure)
whyItWorks: Warm baked refined white-flour pretzel dough has zero dairy, negligible fat, and zero insoluble fiber—making it the #1 emergency carb snack across both Disneyland and California Adventure.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order a plain Classic Mickey Pretzel WITHOUT the plastic cup of jalapeño/processed cheese sauce (or try the sweet Cream Cheese-Filled Pretzel in Tomorrowland/Frontierland with a lactase tablet).
watchOuts: Skip the processed cheese dipping cup; keep a bit of pretzel salt for walking hydration
